concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-subscription-cancel-node]] - Node.js subscription cancellation by ID, including its stated credit-card billing effect, callback and Promise forms, missing-subscription error route, and edit/reactivation limit
warnings: Keep the billing effect in the page's terms: cancellation is presented as the way to stop billing a credit card for the subscription.
Preserve that a canceled subscription cannot be edited or reactivated and that the page directs merchants to create a new subscription.
Do not import cancellation timing, refunds, proration, paid-term forfeiture, customer deletion, payment-method deletion, or neighboring-endpoint semantics.
